full_details: The morning at the Theatre was one line, said twice, and the glass left on the throne because Richard had put it there. You did not ask him why. Michael Drayton brought a specimen sheet to the hall. Two writing-masters are competing for a pen of gold, and you did not enter. You told him you would win it only if they judged by speed. Mistress Ansell took twenty shillings in silver and told it twice. The loaf wants a thumb and the breadth of a nail, and she let the notch speak. Firing and washing are sixpence the week from today. She named the rate and did not take it. The first fire is laid, and not lit. The Shrew is at two, and you are not in it. The Rose plays The Wise Man. You do not go. Evening prayer is a gap. After it, in the narrow book, you ruled twenty-three pound ten, with sixty shillings sewn apart inside that sum for Thursday's carrier. The close knows it will not be Spencer.
one_sentence: You broke once on sceptred, paid the quarter at the hall table, and ruled the coffer at twenty-three pound ten.
title: Broke once on sceptred, paid twenty shillings, and ruled the coffer
